proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : properUnitaryDivisors 1 = ∅ := by
    rw [properUnitaryDivisors]
    -- We need to show that the set of proper unitary divisors of 1 is empty.
    -- This is because Finset.Ico 1 1 is empty and the set is defined as a subset of it.
    simp [Finset.Ico_eq_empty_iff, Nat.lt_succ_iff]
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₂ : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors 1, i = 0 := by
    rw [h₁]
    simp [Finset.sum_empty]
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₃ : ¬ (0 = 1 ∧ 0 < 1) := by
    intro h
    have h₄ : 0 = 1 := h.1
    have h₅ : 0 < 1 := h.2
    -- Since 0 ≠ 1, we derive a contradiction.
    norm_num at h₄
    <;> simp_all (config := {decide := true})
    <;> aesop
  
  have h₄ : ¬ IsUnitaryPerfect 1 := by
    intro h
    have h₅ : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors 1, i = 1 ∧ 0 < 1 := h
    have h₆ : ∑ i ∈ properUnitaryDivisors 1, i = 0 := h₂
    have h₇ : 0 = 1 ∧ 0 < 1 := by
      constructor
      · -- Prove 0 = 1
        linarith
      · -- Prove 0 < 1
        linarith
    exact h₃ h₇
  
  exact h₄
